notes:
Sign-in & Bitwarden update
Price watch: new "Sign in to N stores" button opens ONE window with a tab for every store that needs a sign-in. Sign in on each tab, close the window, and every store is re-checked for you.
Settings: new "Add Bitwarden to the sign-in window" button. Add Bitwarden once from the browser store, sign in to it, and it can fill in store logins in the app's sign-in window. The app never sees your passwords.
